EI.label: Extraversion/Introversion
EI.description: Whether you draw energy from engaging with the outer world (Extraversion) or from time alone with your own thoughts (Introversion).

descriptionThird.he: Whether he draws energy from engaging with the outer world (Extraversion) or from time alone with his own thoughts (Introversion).
descriptionThird.she: Whether she draws energy from engaging with the outer world (Extraversion) or from time alone with her own thoughts (Introversion).

SN.label: Sensing/Intuition
SN.description: Whether you trust concrete, present detail (Sensing) or patterns and possibilities (Intuition).

descriptionThird.he: Whether he trusts concrete, present detail (Sensing) or patterns and possibilities (Intuition).
descriptionThird.she: Whether she trusts concrete, present detail (Sensing) or patterns and possibilities (Intuition).

TF.label: Thinking/Feeling
TF.description: Whether decisions lean on logical consistency (Thinking) or on impact and values (Feeling).

JP.label: Judging/Perceiving
JP.description: Whether you prefer things settled and planned (Judging) or open and flexible (Perceiving).

descriptionThird.he: Whether he prefers things settled and planned (Judging) or open and flexible (Perceiving).
descriptionThird.she: Whether she prefers things settled and planned (Judging) or open and flexible (Perceiving).

openness.label: Openness
openness.description: How drawn you are to new ideas and unconventional thinking versus the practical and familiar.

descriptionThird.he: How drawn he is to new ideas and unconventional thinking versus the practical and familiar.
descriptionThird.she: How drawn she is to new ideas and unconventional thinking versus the practical and familiar.

conscientiousness.label: Conscientiousness
conscientiousness.description: How organized, disciplined, and goal-directed you tend to be.

descriptionThird.he: How organized, disciplined, and goal-directed he tends to be.
descriptionThird.she: How organized, disciplined, and goal-directed she tends to be.

extraversion.label: Extraversion
extraversion.description: How much social engagement and stimulation energize you, versus drain you.

descriptionThird.he: How much social engagement and stimulation energize him, versus drain him.
descriptionThird.she: How much social engagement and stimulation energize her, versus drain her.

agreeableness.label: Agreeableness
agreeableness.description: How much you prioritize cooperation and others' feelings versus your own agenda.

descriptionThird.he: How much he prioritizes cooperation and others' feelings versus his own agenda.
descriptionThird.she: How much she prioritizes cooperation and others' feelings versus her own agenda.

neuroticism.label: Neuroticism
neuroticism.description: How easily you experience stress, worry, or emotional volatility.

descriptionThird.he: How easily he experiences stress, worry, or emotional volatility.
descriptionThird.she: How easily she experiences stress, worry, or emotional volatility.

generator.label: Generator
generator.description: A Human Design type built to respond to what shows up, generating energy by engaging with what lights you up.

descriptionThird.he: A Human Design type built to respond to what shows up, generating energy by engaging with what lights him up.
descriptionThird.she: A Human Design type built to respond to what shows up, generating energy by engaging with what lights her up.

manifesting-generator.label: Manifesting Generator
manifesting-generator.description: A Human Design type combining a Generator's response-driven energy with a Manifestor's instinct to initiate.

manifestor.label: Manifestor
manifestor.description: A Human Design type built to initiate — you act first and inform others, rather than waiting to respond.

descriptionThird.he: A Human Design type built to initiate — he acts first and informs others, rather than waiting to respond.
descriptionThird.she: A Human Design type built to initiate — she acts first and informs others, rather than waiting to respond.

projector.label: Projector
projector.description: A Human Design type built to guide and see systems clearly, working best when invited rather than pushing.

reflector.label: Reflector
reflector.description: A rare Human Design type that reflects the health of the people and environment around them.

red.label: Red
red.description: A color-type energy centered on drive, urgency, and getting things done now.

blue.label: Blue
blue.description: A color-type energy centered on precision, structure, and doing things correctly.

green.label: Green
green.description: A color-type energy centered on harmony, support, and steady relationships.

yellow.label: Yellow
yellow.description: A color-type energy centered on optimism, spontaneity, and connecting with people.
